run_f_gold: run f_gold to replace invalid elements in an array with missing numbers 1 to n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify permutation transformation correctness
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that transforms an array into a permutation of numbers 1 to n
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts element frequencies and replaces duplicates or out-of-range values
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual dictionary for counting
